description_en: Queries alert information based on the alert ID that is specified by the AlertId parameter
description_zh: 调用GetAlertMessage接口，通过获取的AlertId查询报警信息
name: GetAlertMessage

parameters.help_en: The alert ID. You can all the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173961.html operation to obtain the alert ID
parameters.name: alert_id

AlertMessageStatus.description_en:
The sending status of the notification. Valid values:

READY_TO_SEND: The notification is waiting to be sent.
SEND_FAIL: The notification fails to be sent.
SEND_SUCCESS: The notification is sent.
SEND_OVERLIMIT: The number of notifications that are sent exceeds the upper limit
AlertMessageStatus.description_zh:
报警信息的发送状态。取值如下：
READY_TO_SEND（准备发送）
SEND_FAIL（发送失败）
SEND_SUCCESS（发送成功）
SEND_OVERLIMIT（报警超限）

AlertMethod.description_en:
The notification method. Valid values:

MAIL.
SMS.
PHONE. Only DataWorks Professional Edition and more advanced editions support the PHONE notification method
AlertMethod.description_zh:
报警方式。取值如下：
MAIL（邮件）
SMS（短信）
PHONE（电话，仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持）

AlertTime.description_en: The time when the alert was reported
AlertTime.description_zh:
报警时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1553524393000`

AlertUser.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the alert recipient
AlertUser.description_zh: 报警信息接收人的阿里云UID

Instances.description_en: The instances that triggered the custom alert rule. This parameter is returned if the value of the Source parameter is REMIND_ALERT. This parameter is left empty if the value of the Source parameter is not REMIND_ALERT
Instances.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为REMIND_ALERT（自定义提醒）时，返回触发自定义监控规则的实例列表。其它类型的报警来源返回为空

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the node belongs

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

NOT_RUN
WAIT_TIME
WAIT_RESOURCE
RUNNING
CHECKING
CHECKING_CONDITION
FAILURE
SUCCESS
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值如下：
NOT_RUN（未运行）
WAIT_TIME（等待时间）
WAIT_RESOURCE（等待资源）
RUNNING（运行中）
CHECKING（校检中）
CHECKING_CONDITION（条件检测中）
FAILURE（运行失败）
SUCCESS（运行成功）

Nodes.description_en: The nodes returned for different alert sources. The nodes that form a loop are returned if the value of the Source parameter is NODE_CYCLE_ALERT. The nodes that are isolated are returned if the value of the Source parameter is NODE_LONELY_ALERT
Nodes.description_zh:
不同的报警来源返回不同的节点列表：
当Source（报警来源）为NODE_ CYCLE_ALERT（节点成环报警）时，返回成环的节点类型。
当Source（报警来源）为NODELONELYALERT（节点孤立报警）时，返回孤立的节点类型

Owner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the node owner

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the node belongs

RemindId.description_en: The ID of the custom alert rule that was triggered. This parameter is returned if the value of the Source parameter is REMIND_ALERT
RemindId.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为REMIND_ALERT（自定义报警）时，返回触发的自定义监控规则ID

RemindName.description_en: The name of the custom alert rule that was triggered. This parameter is returned if the value of the Source parameter is REMIND_ALERT
RemindName.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为REMIND_ALERT（自定义提醒）时，返回触发的自定义监控规则名称

SlaAlert.description_en: The basic information about the baseline instance that triggered an alert. This parameter is returned if the value of the Source parameter is SLA_ALERT. This parameter is left empty if the value of the Source parameter is not SLA_ALERT
SlaAlert.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为SLA_ALERT（基线报警）时，返回触发基线预警的基本实例信息。当报警来源为其它类型时，返回为空

BaselineOwner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the baseline owner. Multiple IDs are separated by commas (,)
BaselineOwner.description_zh: 基线责任人的阿里云UID，多个UID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔

Bizdate.description_en: The data timestamp of the baseline instance
Bizdate.description_zh: 基线实例的业务日期时间戳

InGroupId.description_en: The ID of the cycle of the baseline instance. Valid values of the ID of an hour-level cycle: [1,24]. The ID of a day-level cycle is 1
InGroupId.description_zh: 基线实例的周期号：天基线为1，小时基线范围为[1,24]

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the baseline belongs

Status.description_en:
The status of the baseline. Valid values:

ERROR
SAFE
DANGEROUS
OVER
Status.description_zh:
基线状态。取值如下：
ERROR（异常）
SAFE（安全）
DANGEROUS（预警）
OVER（破线）

Source.description_en:
The type of the alert. Valid values:

REMIND_ALERT: The alert is a custom alert.
TOPIC_ALERT: The alert is an event alert.
SLA_ALERT: The alert is a baseline alert.
NODE_CYCLE_ALERT: The alert is reported for a node dependency loop.
NODE_LONELY_ALERT: The alert is reported for isolated nodes
Source.description_zh:
报警来源。取值如下：
REMIND_ALERT（自定义报警）
TOPIC_ALERT（事件报警）
SLA_ALERT（基线预警）
NODE_CYCLE_ALERT（节点成环报警）
NODE_LONELY_ALERT（节点孤立报警）

Topics.description_en: The events that triggered alerts. This parameter is returned if the value of the Source parameter is TOPIC_ALERT. This parameter is left empty if the value of the Source parameter is not TOPIC_ALERT
Topics.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为TOPIC_ALERT（全局事件告警）时，返回触发报警的事件列表。当报警来源为其它类型时，返回结果为空

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance that triggered the event

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the node that triggered the event

TopicOwner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the event owner

TopicStatus.description_en:
The status of the event. Valid values:

IGNORE
NEW
FIXING
RECOVER
TopicStatus.description_zh:
事件的状态。取值如下：
IGNORE（已忽略）
NEW（新发现）
FIXING（处理中）
RECOVER（已恢复）

RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
